def smd.zipFnOk (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) (ordered : Bool) (fn :
    GoFunc) (ol or_ : Option (List (GoString × smd.UVal))) (I : List GoString → IProp GF) (Q : IProp
    GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ done k vl vr,
        ⌜smd.mapIterStep ordered (smd.zipKeys ol or_) done k⌝ -∗
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              smd.isAlloc a ∗
                  I done ∗
                    smd.optValF vl (smd.lookupKV k (smd.kvsOrEmpty ol)) ∗
                      smd.optValF vr (smd.lookupKV k (smd.kvsOrEmpty or_)) -∗
                (▷
                    ∀ b,
                      (smd.isAlloc a ∗
                          smd.optValF vl (smd.lookupKV k (smd.kvsOrEmpty ol)) ∗
                            smd.optValF vr (smd.lookupKV k (smd.kvsOrEmpty or_)) ∗
                              if b = true then I (done ++ [k]) else Q) -∗
                        Φ (intoVal b)) -∗
                  WP ((((intoVal fn) (intoVal k)) (intoVal vl)) (intoVal vr)) {{ Φ }})

def smd.iterUFnOk (a : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Allocator) (fn : GoFunc) (kvs :
    List (GoString × smd.UVal)) (I : List GoString → IProp GF) (Q : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ done k x v,

                        Φ (intoVal b)) -∗
                  WP (((intoVal fn) (intoVal k)) (intoVal v)) {{ Φ }})

def smd.isListV_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.List') (vs : List smd.UVal), smd.isListV l vs ⊢ □ smd.isListV l vs

def smd.zipKeys (ol or_ : Option (List (GoString × smd.UVal))) : List GoString :=
  have l := smd.kvsOrEmpty ol;
  have r := smd.kvsOrEmpty or_;
  List.map (fun x => x.fst) (smd.zipLexical (l.length + r.length + 1) l r)

def smd.mapIterStep (ordered : Bool) (keys done : List GoString) (k : GoString) : Prop :=
  if ordered = true then done ++ [k] <+: keys else k ∈ keys ∧ ¬k ∈ done

def smd.UVal.isIntB : smd.UVal → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | smd.UVal.int i => true
  | x => false

def smd.mapIterDone (ordered : Bool) (keys done : List GoString) : Prop :=
  if ordered = true then done = keys else done.Perm keys

def smd.iterFnOk (fn : GoFunc) (kvs : List (GoString × smd.UVal)) (I : List GoString → IProp GF) (Q
    : IProp GF) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□
      ∀ done k x v,
        ⌜smd.lookupKV k kvs = some x ∧ smd.mapIterStep false (smd.kvKeys kvs) done k⌝ -∗

                (▷ ∀ b, (smd.isValF v (DFrac.own 1) x ∗ if b = true then I (done ++ [k]) else Q) -∗ Φ (intoVal b)) -∗
                  WP (((intoVal fn) (intoVal k)) (intoVal v)) {{ Φ }})

def smd.UVal.compare_eq_zero.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : smd.UVal), a.canon = true → b.canon = true → (a.compare b = 0 ↔ a = b)

def smd.zipKeys_mem.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ol or_ : Option (List (GoString × smd.UVal))) (k : GoString),
    k ∈ smd.zipKeys ol or_ ↔
      (smd.lookupKV k (smd.kvsOrEmpty ol)).isSome = true ∨ (smd.lookupKV k (smd.kvsOrEmpty or_)).isSome = true

def smd.mapIterPost (ordered : Bool) (keys : List GoString) (I : List GoString → IProp GF) (Q :
    IProp GF) (r : Bool) : IProp GF :=
  if r = true then iprop(∃ done, ⌜smd.mapIterDone ordered keys done⌝ ∗ I done) else Q

def smd.rangeIfaceM (i : GoInterfaceOk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∀ vs n,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            smd.ownRange (GoInterface.ok i) vs n -∗
              (▷ ∀ b, smd.ownRange (GoInterface.ok i) vs (n + 1) ∗ ⌜b = decide (n + 1 < ↑vs.length)⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal b)) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Next" i.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
      ∀ vs n x,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            smd.ownRange (GoInterface.ok i) vs n ∗ ⌜0 ≤ n ∧ vs[n.toNat]? = some x⌝ -∗
              (▷
                  ∀ j v,
                    ⌜BitVec.toInt j = n⌝ ∗
                        smd.isValF v (DFrac.own 1) x ∗
                          (smd.isValF v (DFrac.own 1) x -∗ smd.ownRange (GoInterface.ok i) vs n) -∗
                      Φ (intoVal j, intoVal v)) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Item" i.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})

                    ∀ Φ,

                            {{ Φ }}) ∗

                        smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq x -∗

                            (▷
                                ∀ m,
                                  smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.map kvs) ∗ smd.isMapV m kvs -∗
                                    Φ (intoVal m)) -∗
                              WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"AsMap" i.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
                    (∀ dq kvs a,
                        □
                          ∀ Φ,
                            smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.map kvs) -∗
                              (▷
                                  ∀ m,
                                    smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.map kvs) ∗ smd.isMapV m kvs -∗
                                      Φ (intoVal m)) -∗
                                WP
                                  ((intoVal
                                      (methods i.ty go!"AsMapUsing"
                                        i.v))
                                    (intoVal a))
                                  {{ Φ }}) ∗
                      (∀ dq vs,
                          □
                            ∀ Φ,
                              smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.list vs) -∗
                                (▷
                                    ∀ l,
                                      smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.list vs) ∗ smd.isListV l vs -∗
                                        Φ (intoVal l)) -∗
                                  WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"AsList" i.v)) (intoVal ()))
                                    {{ Φ }}) ∗
                        (∀ dq vs a,
                            □
                              ∀ Φ,
                                smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.list vs) -∗
                                  (▷
                                      ∀ l,
                                        smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.list vs) ∗ smd.isListV l vs -∗
                                          Φ (intoVal l)) -∗
                                    WP
                                      ((intoVal
                                          (methods i.ty
                                            go!"AsListUsing"
                                            i.v))
                                        (intoVal a))
                                      {{ Φ }}) ∗
                          (∀ dq b,
                              □
                                ∀ Φ,
                                  smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.bool b) -∗
                                    (▷
                                        ∀ r,
                                          smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.bool b) ∗ ⌜r = b⌝ -∗
                                            Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                                      WP
                                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"AsBool" i.v))
                                          (intoVal ()))
                                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
                            (∀ dq n,
                                □
                                  ∀ Φ,
                                    smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.int n) -∗
                                      (▷
                                          ∀ r,
                                            smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.int n) ∗ ⌜r = n⌝ -∗
                                              Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                                        WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"AsInt" i.v)) (intoVal ()))
                                          {{ Φ }}) ∗
                              (∀ dq s,
                                  □
                                    ∀ Φ,
                                      smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.str s) -∗
                                        (▷
                                            ∀ r,
                                              smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq (smd.UVal.str s) ∗ ⌜r = s⌝ -∗
                                                Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                                          WP
                                            ((intoVal
                                                (methods i.ty go!"AsString" i.v))
                                              (intoVal ()))
                                            {{ Φ }}) ∗
                                ∀ dq x,
                                  □
                                    ∀ Φ,
                                      smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq x -∗
                                        (▷ ∀ u, smd.isValF (GoInterface.ok i) dq x ∗ smd.isIface u x -∗ Φ (intoVal u)) -∗
                                          WP
                                            ((intoVal
                                                (methods i.ty
                                                  go!"Unstructured"
                                                  i.v))
                                              (intoVal ()))
                                            {{ Φ }})

def smd.isListV_concrete.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.List') (vs : List smd.UVal),
    smd.isListV l vs ⊢
      (∃ sl, ⌜l = interface.mkOk sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.listUnstructured.ty (intoVal sl)⌝) ∨
        ∃ p, ⌜l = interface.mkOk sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.listUnstructured.ty.PointerType (intoVal p)⌝

def smd.listIfaceM (i : GoInterfaceOk) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∀ vs,
        □
          ∀ Φ,
            smd.isListV (GoInterface.ok i) vs -∗
              (▷ ∀ r, ⌜BitVec.toInt r = ↑vs.length⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"Length" i.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}) ∗
      (∀ vs n x,
          □
            ∀ Φ,
              smd.isListV (GoInterface.ok i) vs ∗ ⌜0 ≤ BitVec.toInt n ∧ vs[(BitVec.toInt n).toNat]? = some x⌝ -∗
                (▷ ∀ v, smd.isValF v (DFrac.own 1) x -∗ Φ (intoVal v)) -∗
                  WP ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"At" i.v)) (intoVal n)) {{ Φ }}) ∗
        (∀ vs a n x,
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                smd.isListV (GoInterface.ok i) vs ∗
                    smd.isAlloc a ∗ ⌜0 ≤ BitVec.toInt n ∧ vs[(BitVec.toInt n).toNat]? = some x⌝ -∗
                  (▷ ∀ v, smd.isAlloc a ∗ smd.isValF v (DFrac.own 1) x -∗ Φ (intoVal v)) -∗
                    WP
                      (((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"AtUsing" i.v)) (intoVal a))
                        (intoVal n))
                      {{ Φ }}) ∗
          (∀ vs a,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  smd.isListV (GoInterface.ok i) vs ∗ smd.isAlloc a -∗
                    (▷ ∀ r, smd.isAlloc a ∗ smd.ownRange r vs (-1) -∗ Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"RangeUsing" i.v))
                          (intoVal a))
                        {{ Φ }}) ∗
            ∀ vs ws a o,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  smd.isListV (GoInterface.ok i) vs ∗ smd.isListV o ws ∗ smd.isAlloc a -∗
                    (▷ ∀ r, smd.isAlloc a ∗ ⌜r = true ↔ vs = ws⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal r)) -∗
                      WP
                        (((intoVal
                              (methods i.ty go!"EqualsUsing"
                                i.v))
                            (intoVal a))
                          (intoVal o))
                        {{ Φ }})

def (sealed) smd.isListV (l : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.List') (vs : List smd.UVal)
    : IProp GF

def smd.UVal.compare_antisymm.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : smd.UVal), a.canon = true → b.canon = true → (a.compare b < 0 ↔ 0 < b.compare a)

def smd.isFieldList_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (a b : smd.FieldList), smd.isFieldList s a ∗ smd.isFieldList s b ⊢ ⌜a = b⌝
